title: Crash sites with Bob Wood that turned out to be US planes

tellings.quote: bobwood and I went to a number of Crash sites with him which all turned out to be our planes

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a guest who appears on the show to talk about life on Mars, says he went to a number of crash sites with a researcher named Bob Wood, and every one of them turned out to be an American plane. He says he was there himself, and the story matters because it suggests some reported crashes of unknown craft were really crashes of our own aircraft.
